observation.command:
for i in $(seq 1 9); do
  if curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:43189/ 2>/dev/null; then echo "app responding"; break; fi
  sleep 55
done
curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 -w "app direct: %{http_code}\n" http://127.0.0.1:43189/ 2>/dev/null || echo "app not yet"
free -m | sed -n '2p'
